notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.zarahome.com/robots.txt) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow, only standard bot/legal-page blocks, so tier (c) is not blocked; however Claude-in-Chrome was disconnected for this run so tier (c) was unavailable regardless. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) hit an Akamai interstitial/bot-manager challenge on both the homepage and category pages (HTTP 200 but a bm-verify JS challenge page, no real content) - confirmed blocked, matches known Zara Home pattern from sister SR21/SR90/SR106. Escalated to tier (b): Playwright headless Chromium launched with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled - this cleared the Akamai challenge on first load and stayed clear for the whole session (all subsequent navigations succeeded). All research done via this tier (b) session; tier (c) never needed. TREE: built via union of (1) the category XML sitemap (https://www.zarahome.com/8/info/sitemaps/sitemap-home-categories-zh-es-0.xml.gz, filtered to the plain /es/ locale, 308 distinct category URLs), (2) the site's full left-hand mega-menu/side-nav tree (.main-menu-side-nav a elements, which render the complete expanded category tree for whichever top-level section is active) captured for Dormitorio, Decoracion/Salon, Bano, Cocina y Comedor, Muebles, Ninos, and Lavanderia, and (3) each leaf category page's own sub-nav pills (.banner-filter-item) where present (e.g. confirmed Basicos sheets split into Lino/Percal/Saten). The side-nav surfaced several nodes absent from the sitemap entirely (e.g. Sets de Cama /dormitorio-juegos-cama-n1798, Ninos Cojines y Mantas /ninos-mantas-cojines-n1115, Ninos Alfombras /ninos-alfombras-n1124, Bebe Ropa de Cuna /bebe-ropa-cuna-n3948) - sitemap alone would have missed these. QTY: Zara Home shows no explicit product-count header/pagination text on category pages; qty was measured by loading each category page, scrolling to the bottom repeatedly until the count of unique product-item permalinks (deduped by href) stopped growing for 3+ consecutive checks, then reading the final stable count. Spot-verified this is a true total (not a windowed/virtualized DOM cap) by comparing unique href accumulation vs displayed DOM node count on two categories - both matched and neither grew further, and no 'load more' control exists on this site. EXCLUDED and why: fragrances/candles/vases/mirrors/photo frames/lighting/tableware/cutlery/kitchen appliances/furniture proper (chairs, sofas, tables, wardrobes, beds) - out of Textile/Storage scope per rules; ninos-tiradores/tiradores-pomos/colgadores-n4857 (knobs, hooks, coat hangers) - hardware/decor accessories, not storage containers; bano-toalleros-n4615 and muebles-toalleros-galanes-n4900 (towel rails/valet stands/room dividers) - bathroom fixtures/freestanding furniture, not storage containers per storage.md boundary rules; cuidado-ropa-lavanderia-colada-n1399 (drying racks, ironing boards, ironing water, textile freshener spray, clothes pegs) - laundry-care tools/equipment, primary type is neither textile nor storage container; bano-neceseres-n4748 (toiletry bags/cases) - breadcrumb places it under ROPA Y ZAPATOS/personal accessories, same boundary as excluded handbags/travel bags, not home storage; decoracion-toppers-sofa-n2492 - inspected product URLs, these are outdoor furniture sets (benches/armchairs) sold with matching cushions, i.e. Furniture, not standalone textile cushions; dormitorio-rellenos-todo-n1384, dormitorio-ropa-cama-n945, ropa-cama-todo-n4129, decoracion-alfombras-salon-n992, salon-alfombras-todo-n4121 - confirmed 'Ver Todo' (View All) aggregate pages for groups whose real children were captured individually, dropped per the View-All and Parent-Category-URL rules; edredon-nordico-n4965 (0 products) and colchas-verano-n4877 (24 products) - both are sitemap-only orphans with no live nav/pill link found anywhere in the mega-menu, side-nav, or their parent category's own pills (Edredones and Colchas both render as flat leaves with zero children in the live site nav), so treated as stale/unlinked sitemap entries and excluded to avoid duplicating Edredones (n950) and Colchas (n951); cashmere-n4193 (0 products, breadcrumb under ROPA Y ZAPATOS) - apparel category, out of scope regardless of count. All URLs recorded are direct category-listing pages, none are product-detail/search/collection/View-All.
